---
title: "R code to generate Barplot across timepoints"
output: html_document
params:
    ordinal_data: NA
    no_doseb: NA
    toxic: NA
    final_t: NA
    ordinal_date: NA
    showExtra: NA
    invert: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    x_lab: "Timepoint"
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer"))

library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)


# Set the parameters
ordinal_data <- params$ordinal_data
no_doseb <- params$no_doseb
toxic <- params$toxic
final_t <- params$final_t
ordinal_date <- params$ordinal_date
showExtra <- params$showExtra

# Function to handle date data
date_to_timepoint_ordinal <- function(data) {
    data %>%
        group_by(id, toxicity) %>%
        arrange(timepoint) %>%
        mutate(date = timepoint, timepoint = row_number() - 1) %>%
        ungroup()
}


# Relabel missing grades as "Unreported"
ordinal_data$grade[is.na(ordinal_data$grade)] <- "Unreported"

# Filter the data for the specified dose and toxicity
ordinal_data <- ordinal_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseb) %>%
    filter(toxicity %in% toxic)

# Calculate the number of patients for each dose at the start of the study (baseline)
if (ordinal_date == TRUE) {
    ordinal_data <- date_to_timepoint_ordinal(ordinal_data)
    n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
        filter(timepoint == min(timepoint), toxicity == toxic) %>% # filter(timepoint == min(as.Date(timepoint)), toxicity == toxic) %>%
        group_by(dose) %>%
        summarise(n.pat = n())
} else {
    n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
        filter(timepoint == min(timepoint), toxicity == toxic) %>%
        group_by(dose) %>%
        summarise(n.pat = n())
}

# Calculate the proportion of patients with each grade for each dose and timepoint
prop <- ordinal_data %>%
    group_by(toxicity, timepoint, dose) %>%
    count(grade) %>%
    left_join(n_pat, by = "dose") %>%
    mutate(proportion = n / n.pat) %>%
    dplyr::select(-n)

# Logic to handle whether to show unreported participants within the barplot (default is to show unreported participants)
if (showExtra == FALSE) {
    ordinal_data <- ordinal_data %>% filter(grade != "Unreported")
    if (ordinal_date == TRUE) {
        n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
            filter(toxicity == toxic) %>%
            group_by(dose, timepoint) %>%
            summarise(n.pat = n())
    } else {
        n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
            filter(toxicity == toxic) %>%
            group_by(dose, timepoint) %>%
            summarise(n.pat = n())
    }

    prop <- ordinal_data %>%
        group_by(toxicity, timepoint, dose) %>%
        count(grade) %>%
        left_join(n_pat, by = c("dose", "timepoint")) %>%
        mutate(proportion = n / n.pat) %>%
        dplyr::select(-n)
}

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(prop) <- c("toxicity", "timepoint", "dose", "grade", "n.pat", "proportion")

prop <- prop %>% dplyr::select(-n.pat)

# Calculate the proportion of patients who have discontinued treatment
missing_layer <- prop %>%
    group_by(toxicity, timepoint, dose) %>%
    summarise(proportion = 1 - sum(proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(proportion > 0)

if (nrow(missing_layer) != 0) {
    missing_layer <- cbind(missing_layer, "Discontinued")
    colnames(missing_layer) <- c("toxicity", "timepoint", "dose", "proportion", "grade")

    missing_layer <- missing_layer %>%
        dplyr::select(names(prop))

    prop$grade <- as.character(prop$grade)
    prop <- bind_rows(prop, missing_layer)
}

# Convert the grade, dose, and toxicity columns to factors for plotting
prop$toxicity <- as.factor(prop$toxicity)
prop$grade <- as.factor(prop$grade)
prop$dose <- as.factor(prop$dose)
prop$dose <- factor(prop$dose, levels = no_doseb)

# Logic to handle ordering of grades
if (params$invert == TRUE) {
    prop$grade <- factor(prop$grade, levels = rev(c("Discontinued", "Unreported", 5:1)))
} else {
    prop$grade <- factor(prop$grade, levels = c("Discontinued", "Unreported", 5:1))
}

# Logic to handle whether timepoint is a date or a numeric value
if (ordinal_date == TRUE) {
    # prop <- prop %>% filter(as.Date(timepoint) <= as.Date(final_t))
    # prop$timepoint <- as.factor(as.Date(prop$timepoint))
    prop <- prop %>% filter(timepoint <= final_t)
    prop$timepoint <- as.factor(prop$timepoint)
} else {
    prop <- prop %>% filter(timepoint <= final_t)
    prop$timepoint <- as.factor(prop$timepoint)
}

if (ordinal_date == TRUE) {
    no_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
        filter(timepoint == min(timepoint), toxicity == toxic) %>% # filter(timepoint == min(as.Date(timepoint)), toxicity == toxic) %>%
        group_by(dose) %>%
        filter(dose %in% no_doseb) %>%
        summarise(n.pat = n(), .groups = "keep")
} else {
    no_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
        filter(timepoint == min(timepoint), toxicity == toxic) %>%
        group_by(dose) %>%
        filter(dose %in% no_doseb) %>%
        summarise(n.pat = n(), .groups = "keep")
}

no_patient <- no_pat$n.pat

# Formatter to assist in subgraph labels to include dose level and number of patients
formatter <- if (isFALSE(showExtra)) {
    ordinal_data <- ordinal_data %>%
        filter(dose %in% no_doseb) %>%
        filter(toxicity %in% toxic) %>%
        filter(grade != "Unreported")
    if (ordinal_date == TRUE) {
        n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
            filter(toxicity == toxic) %>%
            group_by(dose, timepoint) %>%
            summarise(n.pat = n())
    } else {
        n_pat <- ordinal_data %>%
            filter(toxicity == toxic) %>%
            group_by(dose, timepoint) %>%
            summarise(n.pat = n())
    }
    groupsizes <- c()
    for (i in no_doseb) {
        pat_numbs <- n_pat %>%
            filter(dose == !!i) %>%
            distinct(timepoint, n.pat) %>%
            group_by(dose, timepoint)
        groupsizes <- append(groupsizes, paste(unlist(pat_numbs$n.pat), collapse = "; "))
    }
    function(no_dose = no_doseb, no_pat = groupsizes) {
        paste0("Dose ", no_dose, " (N=", no_pat, ")")
    }
} else {
    function(no.dose = no_doseb, no.pat = no_patient) {
        paste0("Dose ", no.dose, " (N=", no.pat, ")")
    }
}


# Plot the barplot
prop %>%
    filter(toxicity == toxic) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(timepoint))) +
    geom_bar(
        aes(
            x = as.factor(timepoint),
            y = proportion,
            fill = as.factor(grade)
        ),
        stat = "identity",
        position = "stack"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        breaks = rev(c(1:5, "Unreported", "Discontinued")),
        values = rev(c("darkgreen", "lightgreen", "yellow", "orange", "red", "grey", "grey30")),
        labels = rev(
            c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe", "Very Severe", "Unreported", "Discontinued")
        ),
        guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    facet_wrap2(~ as.factor(dose),
        nrow = 3,
        strip.position = "left",
        axes = "all",
        labeller = as_labeller(formatter)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = params$x_lab,
        y = "Proportion",
        fill = "Severity Score"
    ) +
    ggtitle(params$title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize))
```
